12 GENS TO CRACK IT.
beats.say: My AIs guess three of thirteen. Watch gen twelve.

end_say: Is your password longer than 13? Comment.

post.title: My AIs cracked a 13 character password in 12 generations
post.caption: My AIs started with 3 of 13 characters right. Gen 4: 8. Gen 8: 11. Gen 10: 12. Gen 12: 2 of them cracked all 13. Two generations later, 45 knew it. This is a genetic algorithm: the closest guesses get copied with random mutations. It only works because the sim scores each guess.
post.pinned: This is a genetic algorithm. Every guess gets a score for how many characters match, the best guesses get copied with random mutations, and it repeats. Real logins do not tell you how close you are, so this does not work on them.
post.notes: Extra reel (Ansh asked for more, Nov 25). Seed 4950, target SHIP WITH PIP (13 chars). best: 3,4,5,8,9,9,10,11,11,12,12,13; solved gen 12: 2, 13: 10, 14: 45. 14 - 12 = 2. Idea test: relatable/question/unrealistic = 3 of 4.
